title: Mexican Galette with Zesty Rice
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make galette dish inspired by Mexican cuisine, served with a zesty rice side.
instructions: Roll out the French Galette Crust to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a pan, sauté the diced onion until softened.
Add the Zesty Seasoning, Garlic Powder, Salt, and Pepper to the pan and stir well.
Transfer the filling to the center of the galette crust, leaving a 1 inch border.
Fold the crust over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Bake the galette for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Cook the Zesty Rice according to package instructions.
Serve the galette with a side of Zesty Rice.
